{{Quote|I think we've found something...|Cutter|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
'''Cutter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was part of a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]] under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Banks''&mdash;uh, Sarge&mdash;take Ghost and Syke and move out. We'll cover you.''"<br />"''We're not leaving you here, Cutter.''"<br />"''You don't have a choice. If these Toma soldiers alert the city before you get there, we're blown. Once we clear these droids, we'll take care of ''them''&hellip; Go&mdash;complete the mission!|Cutter and [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within" />}}
Cutter was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], bred on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Cutter was one of millions of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] who made up the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], though he differentiated himself by painting his [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] designs. That same year, Cutter was sent on a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oznek]], under the direct command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]]. During this time, he was close friends with another clone named [[Syke (clone trooper)|Syke]]. While flying above the planet's forest aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], Cutter, Syke, and [[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]] mocked their new [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] for cleaning his armor and weapons. Banks admonished the team for their behavior, but shortly after that, their ship came under heavy fire. The area was supposed to be unoccupied by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces, but they discovered a large [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], which blasted them out of the sky.

[[File:Cutter2.png|thumb|left|250px|Cutter fights in the forest of Oznek.]]
The LAAT crashed, killing the pilot and several other clones on impact. Syke escaped from the wreckage via a hatch, only to find hundreds of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] bearing down on them. Wielding a [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launcher]], Cutter and the other clones fought off the attacking [[Droid/Legends|droids]] while trying to protect their wounded and [[Burial/Legends|burying]] their dead. Eventually, the waves of unending droids ceased, and the remaining seven clones covered their tracks by detonating a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Setting up camp in the woods, Syke attempted to use a [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]] to no avail. After [[Crazy Legs]] asked, Banks then demonstrated the origin of his nickname&mdash; an unusual ability to calculate angles and bank his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts off of objects without losing their strength and still hitting his target. They were then contacted via [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] by Commander Kishpaugh after Syke managed to get the array working. Kishpaugh informed them that there was a [[Command center|droid command center]] twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away, and that they were to destroy it despite their losses. He then ordered Cutter and the rest of the clone troopers from the shelter, speaking with Banks alone.

Cutter and the others moved out before sunrise, leaving Crazy Legs behind, as he'd broken one of his legs in the crash. They moved through the forest, encountering dangerous terrain and creature everywhere, and lost another clone, who was eaten by an animal. As they traveled, Syke told a war story from early in the conflict, then asked Ghost for a story of his own, but the older clone demurred. Cutter, leading the way, then brought the others' attention to an ancient city in ruins. The clones remarked that their [[scanner]]s hadn't picked up any trace of the large settlement, and suddenly found themselves surrounded by [[Toma]], the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of Oznek. With their hands bound, the clones readied themselves for death after the Toma's leader ordered their executions, but were discovered and attacked by droids once again. Banks asked the Toma to cut their binds so they could fight together, and the Toma did so. Cutter and the others picked up their weapons and held back the droids, but Cutter realized that Banks had to complete their mission. He told the sergeant to take Syke and Ghost, while he and the other surviving clone trooper held off the droids. Banks said that he wouldn't leave Cutter behind, but when Cutter pointed out that the Toma couldn't be allowed to live either, Banks and the others fled.

The mission would turn out to be a falsehood from the beginning, the circumstances and details manufactured by Kishpaugh and Ghost, both of whom were planning to defect to the Confederacy. The price of their escape from the Republic was creating a pretense for war on Oznek&mdash;namely, blowing up a "droid command center" that was really a [[Oznek power plant|power plant]]. Banks managed to foil the plan, killing Ghost and capturing Kishpaugh.
